prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design a genuinely distinctive professional identity for the underground clothing label "PROMPT DEPT." Audience: AI vibe coders, late-night builders, absurd tech culture. Deliver one finished horizontal primary logo on a true transparent background, high resolution. At left, an original iconic cartoon mascot: an angular ivory computer mouse pointer brought to life, sharp arrow silhouette, two half-lidded unimpressed black eyes inside the arrow, tiny espresso cup held by one white-gloved hand, chunky black work boots and confident slouch. Highly economical black ink linework, 1990s independent skate-label character craft, NOT a robot, NOT a cat, NOT Clawd, no recognizable third-party logo. At right, draw a custom tightly kerned two-line wordmark "PROMPT" over "DEPT." with assertive condensed forward-leaning black lettering, softly irregular hand-cut curves and distinctive clipped terminals. The wordmark and character must feel like one clothing label, balanced, legible, ownable, editorial. Black and warm ivory only. No generic PD initials, no pixel blocks, no computer-terminal frame, no background rectangle, no gradients, no glow, no mockups, no extra text, no visual effects. This needs to work as a large tee graphic, embroidered patch silhouette, and small storefront logo. Clean edges, substantial shapes, sharp readable spelling.
